intro: North Macedonian culture is rich in Byzantine churches, folk music and hearty food.

chapters.title: Ohrid
text: Ohrid is said once to have had 365 churches, one for every day of the year; the Church of St John at Kaneo, on a cliff above the lake, is the most photographed.

chapters.title: Film and food
text: The film Before the Rain won the top prize at the Venice Film Festival in 1994, and the documentary Honeyland, about a wild beekeeper, was nominated for two Oscars. Tavče gravče, baked beans, is the national dish.

keyTerms.meaning: Relating to the Eastern Roman Empire and its art and churches.
